summary: Government-backed savings scheme designed for senior citizens to provide a regular income stream.

benefit.displayText: Guaranteed return of 8.2% p.a. (subject to revision)

eligibility.displayText: Age 60 years or above (55 years for retired defense personnel/VRS)

applicationSteps: Visit nearest post office or authorized bank branch
Submit KYC documents and age proof
Deposit amount (min ₹1000, max ₹30 lakh) via cheque or draft
